review_type: Separate-author local boundary review, not production author self-certification
evidence_kinds: Native FastAPI/ASGI request boundary without a model runtime
Committed AW-04 exporter loaded into memory against synthetic source data
Actual ComposerDrafts TypeScript helper transpiled and exercised in a Node VM with controlled browser-storage faults
Static neutral import graph and existing compiled route manifest
coverage: New ownership and resource IDs; original bytes and both artifact versions preserved
Imported displayed messages have no resumable run IDs or model history
Memory restores only with explicit choice; schedules, grants, runs and approvals do not revive
An actual exporter from committed AW-04 can feed the current importer with a synthetic DOCX original preserved byte-exact
A recomputed-valid checksum cannot authorize source workspace/owner changes, system-role messages, version gaps, permission members or traversal
Duplicate JSON keys, NaN, excessive nesting and unpaired surrogates in otherwise complete memory/provenance records reject without partial workspaces
Corrupt DEFLATE produces typed400 at the actual ASGI boundary and no catalogue writes
Preview binds owner/name/memory choices; concurrent different request keys consume one preview only once
Late SQL-trigger failure rolls back the whole imported workspace and leaves the original preview retryable
Idempotent import replay reports current renamed metadata, remains stable after catalogue reopen, and returns404 after confirmed deletion
Deletion removes import lineage and metadata requests, scrubs private import receipt result, and cannot resurrect the deleted identity
Archive is visibility organization: active task blocks archive, archived workspace blocks a new run, saved artifacts remain readable, stale revision conflicts
Independent entry graph excludes legacy layout/styles/auth/proxy; compiled routes contain only neutral app endpoints
Composer scope is per workspace; failed removal falls back to a blank tombstone, both-writer failure stays in-memory and is repaired when storage recovers, and other workspace drafts remain unchanged

findings_closed.finding: After sending/clearing, failed localStorage removal left old text persisted while empty composer suppressed the storage warning and unsafe-navigation guard
findings_closed.resolution: Builder added blank-tombstone fallback, empty-clear failure warning/guard and retry; independent actual helper probe verifies the fallback and recovery. Root owns browser proof of the notice.

findings_closed.finding: Corrupt compressed payload raised uncaught zlib.error instead of a typed invalid-snapshot error
findings_closed.resolution: Builder catches zlib.error narrowly at ZIP read; independent ASGI request now returns400 with zero workspaces created

findings_closed.found_by: backend author self-inspection, confirmed by independent review and Contractor
findings_closed.finding: Import receipt replay could return stale name/revision after the imported workspace was renamed or archived
findings_closed.resolution: Builder overlays current owned workspace metadata onto the immutable import result; independent replay/reopen probe passes

limits: No external calls, real AI quality, model latency/cost, semantic comparison or human acceptance evidence
These are defined-case tests, not a complete adversarial or production security audit
Root owns actual browser E2E, final independent build/start/restart and final source binding; this reviewer did not start or kill live user processes
The neutral graph check covers static source imports and compiled route names, not a complete transitive dependency/license or binary audit
The historical AW-04 compatibility probe uses the committed exporter loaded in memory with synthetic current-format sources, not an imported real user archive

With both browser-storage writers unavailable, no implementation can guarantee a persistent clear after forced process termination; the visible warning, in-tab navigation guard and explicit retry are required and do not claim forensic erasure
Application deletion does not erase retained audits, backups, prior downloads or other devices
Only owned disposable test data was changed; existing workspace catalogue and cookies were not accessed
